recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, airbrushed one-point perspective cityscape at night, characterized by glowing neon billboards, long-exposure light trails on a central road, and a warm, hazy sky. The style features a mix of sharp architectural lines and soft, diffused glows typical of mid-70s commercial illustration.
coreVisualRelationships: Converging light trails leading to a central vanishing point
Large-scale typographic billboards framing the left and right foreground
Warm yellow-orange sky contrasting with cool blue and magenta street tones
Silhouetted figures on sidewalks providing scale to the massive architecture
coreInvariants: Glow effects around every light source
High-contrast lighting between dark building faces and bright neon signs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central road acts as the primary axis, with massive billboards occupying the immediate left and right foreground to create depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, illuminated billboard on the left containing the primary display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the light trails from the bottom center toward the vanishing point, then circles back through the vertical billboards and the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with urban detail and atmospheric haze.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues and blacks for building shadows and road surfaces.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellows and oranges for the sky and neon glows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and cyan for the light trails and specific neon accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in light sources against low-value, dark architectural backgrounds.
paletteRestrictions: Must include warm-to-cool transition from top to bottom

letterConstructionRules: Primary display text uses heavy, rounded geometric sans-serif with inner glow
Secondary text uses a fluid, high-contrast formal script with connected letters
All text is integrated into the scene as physical signage
characterSpecificRedesigns: Rounded terminals on all sans-serif glyphs
Exaggerated swashes on the script 'A' and 'N'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, heavy sans-serif and a delicate, flowing script.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, geometric 70s display feel
Provides the necessary retro script contrast

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s airbrushed illustration of a city at night in one-point perspective. The road should have long-exposure light trails in red, yellow, and white. Include large blank billboards on the left and right foreground. The sky should be a hazy orange-yellow with faint stars.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large yellow geometric sans-serif title to the top-left billboard with an inner glow. Below it, add a white script subtitle on a red illuminated panel. Ensure the text matches the perspective of the billboards.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective consistent across all buildings?
Do the light trails converge at a single point?
Is the airbrushed texture visible in the sky?
Does the text look like it is part of the physical environment?

adjustableVariables: Color of the sky (sunset vs. deep night)
mustRedesign: Identifiable faces on the right billboard
Specific brand names on smaller signs

mustAchieve: Soft, diffused glow on all light sources
Strong sense of depth through perspective

postGenerationChecks: Ensure light trails have a 'motion blur' quality
Verify that neon glows bleed into surrounding surfaces
Confirm the sky has a grainy, airbrushed gradient
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine one-point perspective urban layout + 70s airbrush texture + neon billboard typography + long-exposure light trails.
